gbm_population_evidence.quote: Radiologically or histologically confirmed, newly diagnosed de-novo supratentorial glioblastoma (including gliosarcoma)

candidate_evidence.quote: All patients will be treated with up to two cycles of ipilimumab prior to their standard treatment.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: A Phase I Trial Investigating Neoadjuvant Ipilimumab in Newly Diagnosed Glioblastoma

role_evidence.quote: All participants will be treated with ipilimumab (3mg/kg) for up to 2 cycles.

coder_notes: Neoadjuvant ipilimumab given before standard of care (surgery and chemoradiation). The standard treatment is sequential, follows the study treatment, is not a registered intervention and 'can include' surgery and chemoradiation, so temozolomide is not listed and regimen is coded monotherapy; an adjudicator could argue combination because chemoradiation follows within the treatment plan.
